up: For assay CHEMBL4649962, return canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units for compounds with exact activity measurements.
sql:
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE a.assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649962')
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
